title: Mujhe Hai Karbala Jaana
body:
Karbala Karbala Karbala Ay Karbala
Mujhe Hai Karbala Jaana
Karrar-e-Qalb Hai Paana (x2)
Mujhe Hai Karbala Jaana
1) Khuda Se Iltija Hai Ye
Mere Dil Ki Sadaa Hai Ye
Dar-e-Shabbir Dikhlade
Sawaali Ki Dua Hai Ye
Khudaya Rehm Farmaana
2) Meri Hai Justuju Itni
Meri Hai Aabru Itni
Khudaya Ye Tamanna Hai
Meri Hai Aarzoo Itni
Meri Faryaad Sunn Lenaa
3) Mein Tere Dar Pe Aaya Hun
Jigar Ka Dard Laaya Hun
Meri Bakhshish Karo Maula
Yehi Armaan Laaya Hun
Mujhe Aapna Banaa Lena
4) Namazi Mein Khuda Ka Hoon
Muhafiz Mein Rida Ka Hoon
Dar-e-Shabbir Hai Manzil
Mussaafir Karbala Ka Hoon
Mujhe Manzil Pe Pohchaana
5) Teri Rehmat Ka Sayaa Hai
Hussaini Jo Banaya Hai
Khudaya Mere Dil Me Bhi
Gham-e-Sarwar Samaaya Hai
Karam Ki Bundh Barsaana
6) Mein Duniya Ko Laut Aya
Mein Hasti Ko Mitha Aaya
Koyi Rasta Naheen Bachta
Har Ek She Ko Mitha Aaya
Mujhe Wapis Na Thukraana
7) Kabhi Aissi Bulaa Humko
Dikha Shehr-e-Wafaa Humko
Kahaa Irfan-o-Sadik Ne
Bulaakar Karbalaa Humko
Wahaan Noha Ye Parhwaana
